correctness.rationale: The 27 explicit integral quadratic forms have a 54-element symmetry group with exactly 65 orbits on all 2925 triples. Independent generation of all orbits, modular polynomial arithmetic and Groebner elimination finds 5 potentially nonempty orbits at prime 109, 4 at prime 127, with intersection precisely representatives (0,1,2) of orbit size 18 and (0,4,8) of size 9. A unit ideal on all projective charts after an integral good-prime reduction excludes characteristic-zero geometric solutions by properness of the projective incidence scheme (not merely absence of F_p points). Source exact positive representative charts and the cited pairwise intersection theorem supply the two/one support types; pair uniqueness excludes any fourfold concurrence. There are 351 conic pairs with 4 Bezout intersections each; 1242 + 3*36 + 6*9 = 1404; local Tjurina contribution 1242+4*36+10*9=1476. The orbital exclusion is an exhaustive finite *certificate for the infinite-field assertion*, unlike sampling random points.
